policy.connected_cross_rule: orthogonal sparse geometry + connected topology consensus + explicit filled-dot raster cue + no negative topology channel
policy.false_cross_rule: collinear or duplicate skeleton overlap is proposed as noise, except official sparse endpoint/diverge/turn keypoints are restored as their safe class
policy.non_connected_cross_rule: orthogonal sparse geometry + distinct topology consensus + explicit bridge/gap raster cue + no positive topology channel
